description: This file defines classes, templates, and functions related to a caching host memory allocator in PyTorch, including structures for memory blocks, free lists, statistics, and allocator interfaces. It manages pinned host memory, tracks events and streams, and supports multiple backend implementations.

classes.name: HostBlock
classes.description: Template struct representing a memory block used in pinned memory, tracking size, pointer, streams, and event count.

classes.name: FreeBlockList
classes.description: Template struct for a thread-safe list of free memory blocks.

classes.name: PinnedReserveSegment
classes.description: Manages a pre-allocated pinned memory segment for small allocations, supporting allocation and ownership checks.

classes.name: HostStats
classes.description: Struct for collecting memory allocation statistics and timing metrics.

classes.name: HostStatsStaged
classes.description: Temporary struct for staging statistics to avoid locking during reporting.

classes.name: HostBlockPool
classes.description: Template struct managing a pool of host memory blocks, including all blocks, free lists, and pending events.

classes.name: HostPrivatePool
classes.description: Template struct representing a private pool of host memory blocks associated with a specific mempool ID.

classes.name: CachingHostAllocatorImpl
classes.description: Template class implementing the core logic of a caching host memory allocator, including allocation, freeing, event processing, and stats management.

classes.name: HostAllocator
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for host memory allocators, including methods for event recording, cache management, and stats.

classes.name: CachingHostAllocatorInterface
classes.description: Template class providing a wrapper around a specific implementation of the host allocator, managing data pointers with custom deleters.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a memory block of given size, possibly reusing free blocks or creating new ones.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block, recording events and updating free lists.

methods.name: record_event
methods.description: Records an event on a stream for a memory block to track dependencies.

methods.name: empty_cache
methods.description: Frees all cached host memory blocks.

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Returns current statistics about memory usage and timing.
